10.source_text: : Cut brethren, the situation of things, as they have of late existed, have been to us of a peculiar trying nature. Many of you have been driven from your homes, robbed of your possessions, and deprived of the liberty of conscience; you have been stripped of your clothing, plundering of your furniture, robbed of your horses, your cattle, your sheep, your hogs, and refused the protection of law;…
